description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for the Employee doctype in ERPNext, defining the EmployeeController class, form event handlers, and a user tour for the Employee form.

classes.name: erpnext.hr.EmployeeController
classes.description: Controller class for Employee form, handling setup, refresh, date_of_birth, and salutation logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes query filters for user_id and reports_to fields.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Calls toggle_naming_series to update naming series display.

methods.name: date_of_birth
methods.description: Calls server method to get retirement date based on date of birth.

methods.name: salutation
methods.description: Sets gender field based on salutation value.
